text:
ITEM 1 | Rectangular slice of flatbread-style crust with bright red tomato-sauce topping and melted pale cheese in patches, golden-brown edges with darker browned spots on crust underside, slightly oily sheen, holds shape, approx 12 cm long by 6 cm wide, sitting on the lower-right of the plate | 165
ITEM 2 | Cooked meat pieces, grey-tan to light brown with pale fatty areas, moist and firm, irregular chunks about 4 cm across, with flecks of green herb and some browned edges, sitting upper-right of plate | 90
ITEM 3 | Pale golden-tan rolled or folded pastry piece with lighter layered surface, slightly flaky edges, about 7 cm long by 3 cm wide, with a brown seasoned crust area and a small green garnish flake, next to the meat | 45
ITEM 4 | Small orange-red sauce smears and crumbs scattered at the upper-right edge of the meat, glossy and slightly wet, a few spots about 1 cm across | 8
